title: Power-generated ring maps induce universal homeomorphisms
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $p$ be a prime integer. Suppose $\ker\varphi$ consists of nilpotent elements and $B$ is generated as an $R$-algebra by elements $x$ each satisfying $x^{p^n}\in\varphi(R)$ and $p^n x\in\varphi(R)$ for some integer $n>0$ depending on $x$. Then $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. More explicitly, for every commutative $R$-algebra $R'$ the map $R'\to R'\otimes_R B$ satisfies the same two hypotheses (with the same prime $p$) and induces a homeomorphism on prime spectra.

proof.text: Apply Algebra.adjoin_induction to the predicate that x has an exponent n > 0 with x^(p^n) and p^n*x in the algebra-map range. A scalar has exponent 1. For sums apply [lem-pur-prime-power-addition-subring] to the image subring. For products use exponent n+m, the identities (xy)^(p^(n+m))=(x^(p^n))^(p^m)*(y^(p^m))^(p^n) and p^(n+m)*xy=(p^n*x)*(p^m*y), and closure of the range under powers and multiplication. Since the generators satisfy the predicate and their algebraic adjoin is top, every element satisfies it. This directly implements the subalgebra argument without constructing a separate subalgebra or checking negatives.

The exponents p^n are positive. The nil kernel hypothesis gives ker(algebraMap) <= nilradical R, so [lem-pur-all-element-powers-spectrum-homeomorphism] gives a homeomorphism of the original spectra, in particular surjectivity. Each element is integral: a positive power is a scalar and hence integral, and integrality descends from a positive power.

Prove universal injectivity using the field-valued-point criterion in [def-weil-radicial-morphism]. Two maps B -> K into a field that agree on R agree on every x: if p=0 in K, give K characteristic p and apply injectivity of the n-fold Frobenius to the equality of their images of x^(p^n); if p is nonzero in K, cancel p^n from the equality of their images of p^n*x. Translate the field-valued scheme morphisms through full faithfulness of Spec. Thus the spectrum map is integral, universally injective and surjective; [lem-pc-integral-radicial-surjective-universal-homeomorphism] gives the required universal homeomorphism for arbitrary scheme base changes, including empty schemes.

For an arbitrary R-algebra R', use the proved Algebra.IsUniversalHomeomorphism.tensorProduct and comap_surjective APIs. Their proof identifies the affine tensor spectrum with the fibre product [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] and uses [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change]. Surjectivity implies dense range; PrimeSpectrum.denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical expresses the radical criterion underlying [lem-weil-pbc-zero-locus-eq-iff-radical-eq], so the new kernel is nil. To accommodate R' in a different universe, lift R, B, and R' to their common maximum universe, transfer the original all-element conditions along ULift, apply these same-universe APIs, and transport the resulting nilpotence along ULift.ringEquiv. Algebra.TensorProduct.uliftEquiv identifies the lifted tensor product and carries r' tensor 1 to its lift.

Take s'={1 tensor x | x in s}. Algebra.TensorProduct.adjoin_one_tmul_image_eq_top gives generation. Apply includeRight to the witnesses x^(p^n)=algebraMap r and p^n*x=algebraMap t; its compatibility with the algebra map and the scalar tower gives the identical exponent witnesses over R'. These are the balancing and multiplication properties of [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property]. Repeat step 1 over R' to get positive powers of every element in the new range. Apply [lem-pur-all-element-powers-spectrum-homeomorphism] with the nil kernel from step 4, giving the final tensor-spectrum homeomorphism.
